newsitem.title: USA: Firstmark sells largest land holding.
newsitem.headline: Firstmark sells largest land holding.

text.p: Firstmark Corp said Tuesday it has completed the sale of its largest land holding, 3,167 acres of woodland in Mariaville, Maine, in a transaction that will have no material effect on earnings.

The property, which made up about 20 percent of Firstmark's real estate holdings, consisted of young timber, nearly a mile of paved road frontage and over a mile of water frontage. Firstmark purchased the property in 1993 for $1,130,000. The property produced $1,400,000 in timber revenue during Firstmark's holding period. The sale of the property produced an additional $300,000 in revenue, the company said.
It said income from the property was recognized in prior years as timber was harvested. The current transaction will have no material impact on earings but serves to convert real estate to cash.

Firstmark said the sale is consistent with plans to reduce its real estate holdings in order to better position the company for future activities. Firstmark's remaining real estate holdings include lake front and lake access lots in both Maine and Nova Scotia, it noted.
